Maya (oncall): Quick handoff & FYI for tomorrow morning deploy. Planned work: DB index migration + small model-serving variant rollout. Deploy window: 2026-03-18 09:00 PST. Freeze window: 08:30-10:00 PST. Expected risk: transient query latency spikes during index build and CPU pressure on replica nodes. Canary plan: 5% for 10m -> 25% for 10m -> full. Rollback plan: abort canary and flip feature flag `index_migration_v2` -> off, and route traffic to previous model variant.

Jonathan: Ack — I'll be the primary watcher for the first canary (5%). If p50 latency > 200ms or error rate > 0.5% during canary I'll call abort.

Sophie: I'll take the 25% step and monitor slow-query/dashboard. Which runbook should we follow for index builds?

Maya (oncall): Follow runbook at https://runbooks.internal/redwood/index-migration (link pinned to watchers channel). Quick run commands: `./scripts/check-latency --env prod` and `kubectl get pods -l app=model-serving -o wide`.

deploy-bot: Deploy ticket created: DPL-4321 — https://deploys.internal/DPL-4321 (scheduled 2026-03-18T09:00 PST)

Aisha: Heads-up — I'll be briefly offline 09:45-10:15 PST for a calendar block but can be reached by phone if needed. If any alerts fire in that window can someone page Jonathan to cover?

Maya (oncall): Yes — plan swap: I'll be primary until ~09:40, then Jonathan will cover 09:40-10:30 to catch Aisha's gap. Will update PagerDuty shift and watchers channel.

Jonathan: Got it. I'll add the abort checklist to DPL-4321 and set an immediate-alert rule: p50>200ms OR error rate>0.5% -> abort & notify oncall.

Sophie: Suggest adding a post-canary cache-warm step (top endpoints) after 25% success to avoid thundering requests later.

Maya (oncall): Good call. Add `cache-warm` step after the 25% verification. Example command to run from ops host: ```curl -X POST "https://internal/api/cache/warm" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"keys":["/v1/embeds","/v1/generate"]}'```

Aisha: Also please set auto-rollback flag in deploy UI and attach the backup index snapshot. Thresholds to trigger auto-rollback: p50 > 200ms OR error rate > 0.5%.

Jonathan: I'll snapshot dashboards now and post links in watchers channel. Will also mute non-critical alerts during the canary window and keep paging rules for severity 1.

Maya (oncall): I'll pin the runbook and DPL-4321 link to the watchers channel and leave monitoring notes. If anything unexpected, page the oncall rotation; if you need me specifically, ping @Maya. Thanks — last call for questions before I hand off the shift. :thumbsup:
